div.head: Had 1.3
div.ab: Forðam halidom ⁊ hádas ⁊ gehalgode Godes hus a man sceal for Godes ege wurðian georne.
Forþam halidom ⁊ hádas ⁊ gehalgode Godes hús á man sceal for Godes ege weorðian georne.
Forþam haligdom ⁊ hadas ⁊ gehalgode Godes hus á man sceal for Godes ege wurðian georne.
Quia sanctuaria (sanctificationes) et ordines et Deo dicatas domos semper pro timore Dei debent diligenter uenerari (reuereri ad honorem Dei).
Forðam haligdom and hadas and gehalgode Godes hus a man sceal for Godes ege wurðian georne.
Denn Heiligthum und Ordinirte und geweihte Gotteshäuser soll man stets aus Gottesfurcht eifrig ehren.
For holy things and ordained men and consecrated houses of God must always be eagerly honoured out of fear of God.
For relics and holy orders and the consecrated houses of God must always be zealously honoured for the fear of God.
For out of fear of God, one must always diligently honor the sanctity, orders, and house of God.
